The *Sunāgattheragāthā* (Thag 1.85) is a short canonical poem included in the single-verse section of the *Theragāthā* (*Khuddaka Nikāya*), recording verses attributed to the elder (thera) Sunāga [SuttaCentral]. The text has been translated into multiple modern languages, with SuttaCentral listing twelve translations across ten languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].

No external or cross-canonical parallels are identified for this text in SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus reports no cross-language matches of significant score in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan corpora [DharmaNexus].
